meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

howto.what: 当用户要求安装或配置 NanoClaw 时，Claude 会引导用户在终端运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`。该脚本会自动完成依赖、容器镜像、凭据、服务、首个 agent 等全套初始设置；中途出错会就地提供 Claude 辅助恢复，并从断点继续。
howto.when: 当用户说出“setup”“install”等词，或请求安装、配置 NanoClaw 或首次设置时触发。

say.note: Claude 会让你运行 bash nanoclaw.sh。
Claude 会提示你运行设置脚本。
Claude 会指引你运行 nanoclaw.sh。

howto.what_en: Claude instructs the user to run `bash nanoclaw.sh` in the terminal. This script performs the initial NanoClaw setup: dependencies, container image, OneCLI vault, Anthropic credential, service, first agent, and optional channel wiring. On error, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user asks to install or configure NanoClaw, or mentions "setup", "install", etc.

say_en.note: Claude will tell you to run bash nanoclaw.sh.
Claude will point you to the setup script.
Claude will have you run nanoclaw.sh.
